why_us_section.subtitle: OUR PHILOSOPHY
why_us_section.title:
Dentistry elevated
into art.
paragraphs: At House of Dental, we believe your smile is the first thing the world notices about you - and the last thing you should leave to chance. We've built a studio, not a clinic. A space where precision meets aesthetics, and where every treatment is planned around your face, your goals, and your life.

Our philosophy is simple: beautiful dentistry begins with listening. We take the time to understand what you truly want, craft a plan unique to you, and walk alongside you every step of the way - with warmth, transparency, and clinical excellence.
why_us_section.quote: "A smile is the most powerful thing you wear. We make sure yours is perfectly designed."

google_reviews.name: Priya Ramesh
google_reviews.text: Absolutely the best dental clinic experience in Hennur! Dr. Shweta was so gentle and patient during my root canal treatment. Zero pain, completely sterile diagnostic instruments, and the serene Japandi studio atmosphere instantly relieved all my dental anxiety. Highly recommend House of Dental!

google_reviews.name: Vikram Nambiar
google_reviews.text: Got my smile consultation and clear aligners planned at House of Dental. Completely transparent pricing, state-of-the-art digital intraoral scans, and unmatched professionalism from the dental team. Seeing your simulated 3D teeth movement before starting gives immense confidence. Outstanding 5-star care!

google_reviews.name: Sneha Mukherjee
google_reviews.text: I had severe dental anxiety before visiting House of Dental. The studio feels like a soothing wellness sanctuary rather than a clinical hospital. Dr. Agniss and the team made the cleaning and laser teeth whitening completely pain-free. My teeth look radiant and healthy!

google_reviews.name: Rajesh Varma
google_reviews.text: Exceptional precision and clinical care. Dr. Shweta and Dr. Agniss walked me through every detail of my dental implant with digital X-rays and zero rush. Very honest pricing with no hidden charges. Post-op recovery was seamless. North Bangalore's finest smile clinic.

google_reviews.name: Ananya Sundaram
google_reviews.text: Brought my 6-year-old daughter for her dental check-up and fluoride application. Dr. Shweta was so friendly, warm, and playful that my daughter didn't cry once! The clinic is spotless and kid-friendly. We have definitely found our trusted family dentist in Hennur.

google_reviews.name: Karthik Balakrishnan
google_reviews.text: Had a complicated impacted wisdom tooth removed. Was really nervous about pain, but the surgical team performed the extraction in under 20 minutes with zero discomfort during the procedure. Healing was fast with minimal swelling. Cleanest clinic in Bangalore with modern tech.

google_reviews.name: Meera Chandran
google_reviews.text: Got custom zirconia crowns and aesthetic bonding done here. The craftsmanship and attention to natural tooth shade matching is remarkable. Warm and courteous staff, prompt appointments, and very soothing Japanese-minimalist interiors.
